notes: Starting cards: the Objective (posted 'Hidden Base/Butterfingers1', Butterfingers = the back side Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers) and the cards marked '(start)': Heading For The Medical Frigate, Draw Their Fire, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice ('DODN/WA') and Your Insight Serves You Well ('YISYW'); they count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

The card list leaves out the systems; the author's strategy edit says 'There are 7 systems in this deck' ('I am forgetful, my bad') and names them: Rendezvous Point, Sullust, Endor x2 (Hidden Base indicator), Kessel, Kiffex and Coruscant. They were added as Light printings (Kiffex = the Light Jabba's Palace system; Coruscant = Coruscant (Light) (Special Edition); Endor = the Light Endor system, x2 as posted).
Total as published, with the 7 systems: 59. The Interrupts header says 12 but 11 are listed.

Posted 'Ls, JK' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Artoo' the Jabba's Palace Artoo; 'R5-M2' R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo); 'L in MF' Lando In Millennium Falcon; 'RL in R1' Red Leader In Red 1; 'OOC/TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'HFTMF' Heading For The Medical Frigate.
